items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: and Chick walks around in front of the bandstand and looks up there, and says, "I don't know what you brought him up here for.

ctx.x: So we were talking -- I think we were playing in a place in Newark called the Merry-go-Round, with Stuff, and Tommy was getting ready to -- this was way before Charlie, now, you understand, before Charlie Shavers, and so Bunny, he can't make it this night. He gets a little tipsy and he can't make it, and so then Bud Freeman and Davey Tough was speaking to me and they said, "Well, get Jonah. Get Jonah. He can read the book." So Tommy turned around and said, "Oh, Jonah?" They said yeah. So he took me and then we…
Now, I went on for years, still with Stuff. This is back with Stuff again, around '38, and we went on, then again we were playing -- no -- he called me up.
